messages:
maria: quick PSA — my balcony standing desk (two milk crates + ikea shelf) just made a pop and a tiny spark from the power strip. scared my cat, unplugged everything. pic: https://img.example/porch-wire.jpg

devin: omg unplug first. are you ok? any smell of burning? :sweat_smile:

maria: all good, just a plastic-y smell for a sec, then nothing. no visible burn marks. cat inspected and gave me a look of contempt. :cat:

sam: good call. if that strip is old swap it. get a proper surge protector, not the cheapest extension. APC is decent — `APC-P8U` worked for me for years.

joan: also check the outlet for wobble or discoloration. heat + loose prongs = bad news. remove power-hungry gear from balcony during storms.

lia: yikes. want me to drop off a USB-C dock and a spare surge tomorrow? I have one collecting dust.

maria: that would be amazing, thank you — will take it inside tonight. temporary standing until new desk ships.

devin: :thumbsup: glad you're okay. are you running a heater out there or anything that could add heat?

maria: nope just laptop + lamp. lamp uses LED but the strip was on the edge. unplugged the lamp and the router just to be safe.

joan: small lifehack — put a smoke detector near your balcony door if you keep devices out there. cheap and worth it.

sam: also fwiw, if you need a quick surge recommendation: `Anker 8-Outlet 39W`, get one with USB-C PD passthrough.

maria: filing a tiny incident note for myself so I remember to replace the strip. :memo:

devin: poll time: react with :sun_with_face: if you prefer working on a balcony/porch, react with :house: if you prefer inside. I bet balcony wins.

ops-bot: Reminder — People Ops covers up to $75 for home office safety equipment (surge protectors, certified power strips). Submit receipts at https://redwood.example/people-ops-expenses.

lia: also pinging @maria if you want help hauling electronics in later. my truck is small but heroic. :truck:

maria: thanks team — all cords boxed, router on battery for now, cat back to judging. appreciate the dock offer, will DM.
